name: worker-assignment-app
description: Root orchestration for deployment - installs/builds the client and server as one unit (see README > Deploying it live). The Render deployment itself now uses the Dockerfile at the repo root instead of these scripts (see README > 17.2), since Render's plain Node build environment can't run `playwright install --with-deps` (it isn't allowed to become root). This file is kept for local/manual builds on a machine that already has the OS libraries Chromium needs (a normal desktop does) and for any future non-Docker host.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install && npx --prefix server playwright install chromium
